summary: TC Energy filed a Form 6-K to furnish a news release and Report of Voting Results from its 2026 annual meeting of shareholders. The filing reports that 13 nominees were elected to the board of directors with overwhelming support (99%+ votes for most nominees). No dissent, no activist campaign, no transaction or corporate action is described. This is a routine disclosure of an AGM outcome by a foreign private issuer. The 6-K furnishes the results under the Canadian continuous disclosure regime. There are no deal terms, no special situation, and no event other than a regular director election. The filing is purely informational and carries no strategic or structural significance.
